blurb: A long seizure triggers the urgent screen first.

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})-[:HAS_CHILD]->(c:Child)
RETURN f.id AS id, f.kb_version AS kb_version, f.consent_centre AS consent,
       c.age_months_at_start AS age_months, c.sex AS sex, f.created_at AS created_at
queries.name: f_get_family

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})
RETURN f.phase AS phase, f.round_no AS round_no, f.updated_at AS updated_at
queries.name: f_get_state

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})-[:HAS_CHILD]->(c:Child)
SET c.age_months_at_start = $age, c.sex = coalesce($sex, c.sex)
RETURN c.age_months_at_start AS age
queries.name: f_set_age

queries.cypher:
MERGE (s:Story {text_hash: $hash})
ON CREATE SET s.at = $at
RETURN s.text_hash AS hash
queries.name: f_add_story

queries.cypher:
MERGE (f:Flag {rule_id: $rule_id, quote_hash: $qhash})
ON CREATE SET f.level = $level, f.at = $at, f.quote = $quote
RETURN f.rule_id AS rule_id
queries.name: f_add_flag

queries.cypher:
MERGE (f:Flag {rule_id: $rule_id, quote_hash: $qhash})
ON CREATE SET f.level = $level, f.at = $at, f.quote = $quote
RETURN f.rule_id AS rule_id
queries.name: f_add_flag

queries.cypher:
MERGE (e:Event {id: $id})
ON CREATE SET e.kind = $kind, e.label = $label, e.at = $at
RETURN e.id AS id
queries.name: f_add_event

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})
RETURN f.phase AS phase, f.round_no AS round_no, f.updated_at AS updated_at
queries.name: f_get_state

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})
SET f.phase = $phase, f.round_no = $round_no, f.updated_at = $at
RETURN f.phase AS phase
queries.name: f_set_state

messages.plain: This sounds like a seizure that may be long or may be happening again. Please call your local emergency number now. While you wait, lay your child on their side on a soft surface, do not put anything in their mouth, and stay with them.
A child who cannot be woken or is not responding needs help right away. Please call your local emergency number now. If they are breathing, lay them on their side and stay with them.

steps.caption: A safety rule fires first; nothing else happens.

payload.banner: This needs urgent medical help. Call your local emergency number now (112 in India and Europe, 911 in the US) or go to the nearest emergency department. Your answers are saved — come back when your child is safe.
payload.disclaimer: Constellation does not diagnose. It helps you gather information and decide when to see a doctor. Always follow your doctor's advice. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
